decisions.reason: A coffee-based men's care series is a niche line outside the firm's core range and is somewhat vulnerable, but small German cosmetics makers usually keep a launched series running for several years, and there is no evidence that it has been withdrawn.
The cleansing foam extends the established Sandorini (sea buckthorn) line and shares its branding and production, so it is cheap to keep and likely to stay as part of the core series.
